research_role: one economically distinct second-engine test of own-history-relative speculative turnover, not another Champion modifier

source_prior.mechanism: unusually intense stock-specific trading reflects speculative disagreement and overpricing, so abnormally high turnover should predict weaker subsequent returns
source_prior.primary_reference: Pan, Tang, and Xu (2016), Speculative Trading and Stock Returns, Review of Finance 20(5), 1835-1865, DOI 10.1093/rof/rfv059
source_prior.local_formulation_boundary: The original Pan event-dummy residual ATR cannot be reproduced because the required event history is not registered. This test is an explicitly labeled simple turnover-surge ratio, independently specified as current monthly turnover divided by its own prior-twelve-month norm; it is not called a canonical Pan ATR replication.

frozen_signal.clock: last exchange session of each calendar month after the completed 15:00 daily bar
frozen_signal.current_month_turnover: sum of causal turnover_fraction over the completed calendar month
frozen_signal.own_history_norm: simple average of the preceding twelve complete calendar-month turnover sums
frozen_signal.orientation: lower is preferred; high values indicate relative speculative turnover surge
frozen_signal.history_completeness: current month and every one of the preceding twelve months must each contain at least fifteen valid tradable stock sessions, and the twelve month keys must be calendar-contiguous
frozen_signal.eligibility: exact registered Cycle-015 PIT daily eligibility at the month-end date, including non-ST, valid industry, continuous causal price history, and prior-20 average amount at least CNY 50 million
frozen_signal.earliest_entry: next legal session open after the month-end signal
frozen_signal.natural_exit: the next calendar-month signal's next legal session open; if the stock cannot sell, delay under the unchanged execution contract

cheap_screen.dates: 2019-01 month-end through 2023-10 month-end; 2023-11 month-end supplies the last causal rebalance exit and no post-2023 row is needed

sample_arms_per_date.Q1_to_Q5: twenty deterministic SHA-256 samples from each same-date score quintile using seed STR-V1
sample_arms_per_date.date_control20: twenty deterministic SHA-256 samples from the complete same-date eligible set using seed STR-CONTROL-V1

cheap_screen.outcome: net next-open-to-next-month-next-open return after 20 bps per side, with PIT actions, limits, suspensions, T+1, delayed exits, and QD-010 pre-effective exits

single_replay_if_both_gates_pass.selection: the exact ten lowest score stocks at each completed calendar month-end
single_replay_if_both_gates_pass.rebalance: sell the prior monthly cohort and buy the new cohort at the next legal open, using only available cash and never borrowing
single_replay_if_both_gates_pass.target_window: include cash from 2018-01-02 until the first lawfully formed signal so the headline annualized return spans the same 2018-2023 development window
